text:
Sophie: Heads-up — support seeing a cluster of trial tickets from CuraHealth (team of 12) saying the onboarding checklist shows 'Complete' but admin users can't invite teammates. Two tickets (T-9832, T-9840) include screenshots where the invite button is greyed out and shows a 403 in the console.

Priya: Putting this to P1 for support-to-CS handoff. Customer mentions renewal in 6 weeks and adoption looks stalled.

Alex: Sharing quick repro from staging: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invite -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"email":"user@cura.health","role":"member"}'``` returns 403 with body `{"error":"forbidden","reason":"org_invite_restricted"}`. Happens only for orgs created before Feb 2026 (migrated schema).

Sophie: Also saw client-side log: `Uncaught (in promise) Error: Invite failed (403) — permission: invite_users` — multiple users tried with admin role. Ticket includes CSV of 9 affected emails.

Jamie: Thanks. @Maria can CS lead outreach? Renewal risk flagging now. We should do an enablement session + coordinated comms.

Maria: Yep. Proposed plan: 1) Immediate: prioritize a 30m remediation call with CS+Support+SE today. 2) Within 24h: scripted email to affected org admin (draft below). 3) 48-72h: live enablement walkthrough + invite flow QA. 4) Follow-up: success metric = ability to invite 95% of users within 72h and daily adoption delta. Owners: Maria (CS lead), Alex (SE), Priya (Support), Sophie (ticket owner).

Alex: Technical note — looks like a migration toggle in auth-service defaulting to 'restrict_invites' for migrated orgs. Quick fix: flip flag for CuraHealth while we roll a patch. Patch ETA 6 hours.

Sophie: I'll scope exact accounts and attach ticket links: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/T-9832 , https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/T-9840. Also customer quoted: "We can't onboard our pilot staff, this blocks our go-live next month."

Maria: Draft email (please edit): "Hi <Admin>, we saw an issue preventing invites for some accounts migrated in Feb. We're scheduling a fix and a short enablement session. Can you join today at 4pm PT? If not, propose times. We will temporarily enable invites for your org and walk through onboarding."

Priya: Support will apply temporary toggle now for the two orgs and post results here. I will also add a note to renewal tracker (account health = 'at risk') and link to playbook: /playbooks/onboarding-escalation.

ops-bot: Incident link created — https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-20260323-47 — team: eng-runtime, eng-platform, support, cs.

Jamie: Okay — Maria pls take lead on customer comms. @Alex confirm when toggle applied so Support can verify and close tickets. Maria, schedule the 30m call and include SE + support. I'll update CSM dashboard with renewal signal and comm plan.

Alex: Toggle applied to cura-123 and cura-456 at 2026-03-23T16:12Z. Invite tests passed (5/5). Leaving a note in the tickets.

Sophie: Customer confirmed they could invite 3 users. They accepted 4pm PT call. Marking the thread for follow-up: reopen if invite errors persist. :thumbsup:

Maria: Following up after call — capture: enablement done, invited 9/9, customer happy, renewal risk downgraded to 'monitor'. I'll file feedback item: improve migrated-org invite UX + automated migration checks.

Priya: Closing tickets after verification. Adding retro item to support backlog to detect this migration toggle proactively.

Jamie: Great work. Add a short blurb to next weekly health sync so Product + Eng see the migration edge case.

Maria: Will do — creating ticket in CS backlog and tagging @product.

Sophie: Thanks everyone.
